args.title: Fix issue 4403 in src/export/csv.ts
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The file src/export/csv.ts controls the CSV export and deliberately prefixes the UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM) by default when creating CSV files (bom defaults to true). This BOM is there on purpose to help spreadsheet apps detect UTF-8 encoding. To avoid the BOM, this option would need to be changed in this file or in code calling writeCsv.
